sources.title: SO-101 Vials DR Randomized Grasp - Physical AI Dataset | Claru
sources.snippet: A simulation dataset of 250 successful scripted episodes for a robotic arm performing vial grasping tasks with domain randomization. The dataset includes RGB video from wrist and external cameras, proprioceptive state, and joint position actions.

sources.title: SO-101 DR with STS gripper protection - claru.ai
sources.snippet: 250 successful single-environment simulated vial-to-rack demonstrations recorded at 30 FPS with external and wrist cameras, using domain randomization for lighting, mat appearance, and robot color.
